system.description:
• Your power over the dead: Animate Dead, Undead Mastery (see Core Chassis) and Soul Tax, below, work as one feature.
  • Animate Dead: Animate one corpse as a skeleton or zombie without expending a spell slot. Each free use is one corpse, uses the spell's action and range, and needs no onyx; Undead Mastery and Soul Tax replace the spell's duration and control limits.
  • Free daily uses scale with level: 1 use (levels 1-4), 2 uses (levels 5-9), 3 uses (levels 10-14), 4 uses (levels 15-19), 5 uses (levels 20+)
  • You begin play with one skeleton you have already raised.
  • Additional uses beyond the daily free limit require a 3rd level slot each (from 5th level); each raises one corpse
  • Animated undead count towards your Undead Mastery cap (a skeleton or zombie is 1 point) and persist until destroyed or dismissed
  • While you are Unconscious your undead finish their last order, then guard you. If you die, they break free at the next dawn; the GM determines their behaviour
  • At the table: your undead act together on your initiative and move as a group.
  • In a fight your undead act as squads: all your undead of one kind form one squad.
  • A squad makes one attack roll and deals one creature's damage, +1 for each other creature in it.
  • Each creature still takes damage, saves and is destroyed on its own.
  • Soul Tax: Each dawn, you maintain undead worth up to half your Undead Mastery cap in points (rounded up) for free.
  • Beyond that, each undead costs a spell slot of a level equal to its points or higher, or you lose control of it.
  • Upkeep may use no more than half your total spell slots (rounded up) each dawn.
  • Undead points by Level:
  • Undead whose slot cannot be paid immediately break free; the GM determines their behaviour
